Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0145", "row_sha256": "fbb36fb7a8148d686e2ee095571b2821cbe016e665aca880ca53813b56909038", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "okay this is for mara about friday's run in the harbor room i'm forwarding the revised lighting cue sheet to you before lunch because the crew needs the new timing at the afternoon call the change is only for the second scene and the practical lamps stay on the same circuit first the blue wash comes up after the door closes second the desk special holds through the short pause and third the aisle lights fade only when the last actor reaches the stairs please keep the old sheet beside the console until devon checks the channel numbers i marked the two borrowed fixtures with yellow tape and wrote the return date on the case label the dimmer rack has been quiet since tuesday but the spare fader still sticks near the bottom so let me know if it drops during the cue check i can meet you by the loading door at one with the printed copy and the pencil notes from rehearsal if the stage manager moves the afternoon call tell me before you post the schedule okay that's all for mara", "output": "Okay, this is for Mara about Friday's run in the Harbor Room. I'm forwarding the revised lighting cue sheet to you before lunch because the crew needs the new timing at the afternoon call. The change is only for the second scene, and the practical lamps stay on the same circuit. First, the blue wash comes up after the door closes; second, the desk special holds through the short pause; and third, the aisle lights fade only when the last actor reaches the stairs. Please keep the old sheet beside the console until Devon checks the channel numbers. I marked the two borrowed fixtures with yellow tape and wrote the return date on the case label. The dimmer rack has been quiet since Tuesday, but the spare fader still sticks near the bottom, so let me know if it drops during the cue check. I can meet you by the loading door at one with the printed copy and the pencil notes from rehearsal. If the stage manager moves the afternoon call, tell me before you post the schedule. Okay, that's all for Mara."}]
